judgments.reason: The candidate is the original Wang et al. 2016 benchmark SSVEP dataset paper. It matches the dataset's authors, its 40-target speller with 8–15.8 Hz stimulation, and its 64-channel EEG (35 subjects reported, 34 in this release).
judgments.paper_title: A Benchmark Dataset for SSVEP-Based Brain–Computer Interfaces
judgments.paper_venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering
